_note: Meaning of each XML tag and cli_param/server_param/custom_field option, taken from the notes above. Anything not described there is marked undocumented rather than guessed.

tags.game_config: Root element. There can only be one per file; every other element is contained within it.
tags.game_key: Unique identifier for the game server definition. Alphanumeric and underscores only. Should end with a platform suffix (_win32, _win64, _linux32, _linux64; _win and _linux also work but are discouraged) so the Panel knows which OS it applies to.
tags.protocol: Query protocol used by the Panel. Known values: lgsl, gameq, rcon (rcon2/lcon mentioned as undocumented alternates).
tags.lgsl_query_name: Key referencing this game server in the LGSL protocol file, used to query the server.
tags.gameq_query_name: Key referencing this game server in the GameQ protocol files, used to query the server.
tags.installer: Install method for the game server, e.g. steamcmd.
tags.game_name: Display name shown in the Panel's game list.
tags.server_exec_name: Server executable name used when building the start command line.
tags.query_port: Offset between the server port (%PORT%) and the query port (%QUERY_PORT%). type is add or subtract.
tags.cli_template: Template for the command line placed after the server executable name. Built-in variables (used between % characters): GAME_TYPE, HOSTNAME, IP, MAP, PID_FILE, PLAYERS, PORT, QUERY_PORT, BASE_PATH, HOME_PATH, SAVE_PATH, OUTPUT_PATH, CONTROL_PASSWORD. Custom variables can also be defined via cli_params/server_params.
tags.cli_params: Defines the known variables used in cli_template.
tags.cli_param: One variable definition: id is the %VAR% name, cli_string is what replaces it, options controls formatting (see cli_param_options).
tags.reserve_ports: Reserves additional ports for use in the generated start command line and in firewall management.
tags.port: One reserved port entry: type is add or subtract (offset from the game server's port), id is the %VAR% name, cli_string is the flag text, the element's own value is the offset amount.
tags.cli_allow_chars: Special characters to allow in the command line in addition to the default-escaped set (\ " ' | & ; > < ` $ ( ) [ ]).
tags.maps_location: Path to the maps folder, used to generate a selectable map list for %MAP%.
tags.map_list: Path to a text file (one map per line) used to generate a selectable map list for %MAP%.
tags.console_log: Path to the log file shown on the server's LOG page. Mostly needed on Windows.
tags.exe_location: Path to the server executable when it is not in the root folder.
tags.max_user_amount: Maximum player count selectable when creating the game server.
tags.control_protocol: Protocol used for remote control: rcon, rcon2, or lcon (legacy). rcon can also carry control_protocol_type of old or new.
tags.control_protocol_type: Sub-type for control_protocol rcon: old or new.
tags.mods: Defines the selectable mods/variants for this game server.
tags.mod: One mod entry: key identifies it (the default one is the base game itself), installer_name is the Steam appID used to install/update it, installer_login the SteamCMD login to use (anonymous unless noted).
tags.replace_texts: Defines text replacements applied to config files on server start, driven by Panel-generated values.
tags.text: One replace-text entry: default is the regex matched at line start, var is the key kept when replacing, filepath is the file modified, options controls formatting (see text_options).
tags.server_params: Defines selectable/togglable startup parameters shown on the game server's configuration page.
tags.param: One server param: id is the %VAR% name used in cli_template, key is the flag/text inserted, type is text, select, or checkbox_key_value (see param_types), options controls formatting (see param_options).
tags.custom_fields: Defines custom fields (Custom Fields button) applied to config files on every server start.
tags.field: One custom field: key/var/filepath identify what line to replace in which file, default is the regex matched, default_value is what the UI pre-fills, options controls formatting (see custom_field_options).
tags.list_players_command: Command sent to list players on the server when using control_protocol.
tags.player_info_regex: Regex used to parse player info when using control_protocol.
tags.player_info: Maps regex capture group indexes to named fields (e.g. userid, Name) for control_protocol.
tags.player_commands: Defines admin commands (kick/ban/rename, etc.) available when using control_protocol.
tags.command: One player command: type is hidden, select, or text; string is the control-protocol command template with %input%/%userid%/%Name% placeholders.
tags.pre_install: Script executed before installing/updating the game server.
tags.post_install: Script executed after installing/updating the game server. XML special characters in the script must be escaped (e.g. ", >).
tags.pre_start: Script executed just before the server starts (batch on Windows, bash on Linux). Runs with the server's home directory as the working directory.
tags.environment_variables: Environment variables to set before starting the server. {GSP_HOME_DIR} is replaced with the server's home directory.
tags.lock_files: Additional files to protect (chattr +i on Linux) after install/update, before the server starts. Relative paths are relative to the server's home directory.
tags.configuration_files: Files directly editable from the Panel without server file access (requires the EditConfigFiles module).
tags.file: One editable config file entry under configuration_files; description is optional UI text.

cli_param_options._undocumented_default: no options = no quotes or spacing added

text_options.sqc: space, quoted, ends with a comma

param_types.text: Free text box; value replaces the %VAR% in cli_template using key as the prefix. Empty input removes the variable entirely rather than replacing it.
param_types.select: Dropdown of fixed options; the chosen option's value replaces the %VAR% using key as the prefix.
param_types.checkbox_key_value: Checkbox; when ticked, adds key verbatim to the command line.

param_options.ns: no space between key and value
param_options.q: quotes wrapped around the value after key (no space)
param_options.s: space added after key before value (no quotes)
param_options._other: space after key and quotes around the value (any other/undocumented option value)

custom_field_options._note: No dedicated options table is given in xml-notes.md; the field reuses the same style of options seen on replace_texts/text (s/q/sq/sc/sqc) and server_params/param (ns). Treat any specific value not already listed in those tables as undocumented.

reserve_port_types.add: Offset is added to the game server's port.
reserve_port_types.subtract: Offset is subtracted from the game server's port.

control_protocol_values.rcon: RCON protocol; can carry control_protocol_type old or new.
control_protocol_values.lcon: Legacy control protocol (marked legacy in the notes).

protocol_values.rcon: Query via RCON. Also listed with unconfirmed variants rcon2/lcon in the notes (marked undocumented there).
